verdict.rationale: telli documents a Test call feature in the agent builder. It lets you test a draft or any saved revision before deployment, then review the recording alongside the transcript. That covers manual pre-launch testing, but there is no evidence of automated simulated conversations, scripted test personas, or eval suites. missing for 10: automated simulated conversations (agent-vs-simulated-caller), eval/test-case suites with pass/fail scoring, clarity on whether test calls avoid the real phone network, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can test agents with simulated conversations or evals before putting them on real phone calls

citations.quote: In the agent builder, click Test call to open the dialog. Pick the agent version (your draft with unsaved changes or any saved revision)
Use the side-by-side view to listen to the recording while following along in the transcript.
